summary.business_type: E-commerce + Local Producer (Premium Sicilian Extra Virgin Olive Oil)
summary.stack: Next.js 15 App Router / Vercel / MongoDB / Cloudflare R2 / Stripe
top_findings: All 6 product pages return HTTP 500 — site not indexed by Google (site: query returns 0 results)
Product page.tsx is 'use client' — product content invisible to crawlers
JSON-LD injected via next/script afterInteractive + Math.random() ID (hydration mismatch)
www/non-www split with 307 TEMPORARY redirects contradicting canonical tags
Hero video is 29 MB 4K MP4 with no poster + hero text has opacity-0 on SSR — zero LCP candidate
quick_wins: Replace placeholder address in it.json:282 (5 min)
Fix metadataBase fallback .it → .com in layout.tsx:45 (5 min)
Add OG image and logo to /public/images/ (10 min)
Create /public/llms.txt for AI search readiness (30 min)

findings.title: Product pages are fully Client-Side Rendered
findings.description: src/app/(shop)/products/[slug]/page.tsx opens with 'use client'. All product content fetched via useProductBySlug() hook after JS hydration. Initial HTML = loading spinner only.
findings.recommendation: Convert to Server Component. Remove 'use client', use getProduct() already available in layout.tsx. Isolate interactive children as separate Client Components.

findings.title: JSON-LD structured data never in server-rendered HTML
findings.description: StructuredData component uses next/script without strategy prop (defaults to afterInteractive). Also uses Math.random() for ID causing React hydration mismatch.
findings.recommendation: Use inline <script type='application/ld+json' dangerouslySetInnerHTML> in Server Components. Use stable deterministic IDs.

findings.title: www/non-www 307 temporary redirect contradicting canonicals
findings.description: oliogalia.com/products → 307 (temporary) → www.oliogalia.com/products. Canonical on www points back to non-www. 307 does not pass PageRank.
findings.recommendation: Add permanent redirect in vercel.json: www.oliogalia.com → oliogalia.com with permanent: true.

findings.title: OG image and logo return 404
findings.description: /images/og-image.jpg and /images/logo.png both return 404. Every social share shows blank image. Organization schema invalid.
findings.recommendation: Add files to /public/images/ or update paths to R2 CDN URLs in metadata.ts and structured-data.tsx.

findings.title: English content completely uncrawlable — zero hreflang
findings.description: Locale stored in localStorage, never in URL. /en → 404. No hreflang tags anywhere. html lang='it' translate='no' globally.
findings.recommendation: Implement Next.js App Router [locale] segment routing (/en/products, /it/products). Add hreflang alternates. Submit EN sitemap.

findings.title: HTTP 500 on all 6 product pages
findings.description: All product URLs in sitemap return HTTP 500. Next.js injects noindex on 500 pages. Google actively de-indexes them.
findings.recommendation: Debug Vercel function logs for /api/products/[slug]. Check MongoDB connection string and environment variables.

findings.title: metadataBase fallback uses wrong TLD (.it instead of .com)
findings.description: layout.tsx:45 and subscribe/layout.tsx:3 both fallback to 'https://oliogalia.it'.
findings.recommendation: Change both fallbacks to 'https://oliogalia.com'. Confirm NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://oliogalia.com in Vercel settings.

findings.title: Missing critical security headers
findings.description: Missing: X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Content-Security-Policy, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy. HSTS present but missing includeSubDomains and preload.
findings.recommendation: Add headers configuration to next.config.ts for all 5 missing headers.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Three-brother team with credentials in data

findings.title: FAQ Q&A content exists in it.json but FaqListSection component doesn't render it
findings.description: 8 fully-written Q&A pairs in src/data/locales/it.json (production method, DOP claim, certifications, farm visits) are not displayed. Live page shows only heading.
findings.recommendation: Debug FaqListSection component — fix data-prop passing or rendering guard that prevents Q&A from displaying.

findings.title: Hero description fields are empty strings
findings.description: hero.description.main and hero.description.secondary = '' in both it.json and en.json. Above-the-fold shows only three single-word headings.
findings.recommendation: Fill description fields with actual marketing copy describing the brand and product.

findings.title: Contact info placeholders never replaced
findings.description: FAQ contact block in it.json contains info@example.it and +39 XXX XXX XXXX — may render as live contact information.
findings.recommendation: Replace with actual contact info: info@oliogalia.it and +39 3793475975.

findings.title: Homepage H1 is brand name only — no keyword
findings.description: H1 = 'Olio Galia' with no keyword. Search engine cannot determine primary topic.
findings.recommendation: Change to: 'Olio Extravergine di Oliva Biologico Siciliano — Olio Galia'

findings.title: No blog or informational content — zero top-of-funnel coverage
findings.description: No blog section exists. Zero pages target informational queries (EVO benefits, production process, Tonda Iblea guide, DOP Monti Iblei).
findings.recommendation: Create minimum 3 blog posts: EVO benefits, production process, Tonda Iblea/DOP guide.

findings.title: Family photos are code TODOs — not inserted
findings.description: /nonno-paolo-1940.jpg and other family photos referenced as TODOs in source code. Strongest E-E-A-T lever for a family producer is not deployed.
findings.recommendation: Insert actual family/production photos throughout the About page.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Privacy policy, T&C, cookie policy present

findings.title: Wrong town in root layout description — NAP contradiction
findings.description: layout.tsx:47 description: '100% Olio Extravergine da Cassaro, Sicilia'. Cassaro is a different comune ~10km from Ferla. Every other page correctly says Ferla (SR).
findings.recommendation: Change to: 'Olio extravergine di oliva Tonda Iblea prodotto a Ferla (SR), Sicilia, dal 1940.'

findings.title: Footer address is an unreplaced placeholder
findings.description: src/data/locales/it.json:282 = 'Via Example 123, Città'. If NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTACT_ADDRESS env var not set, every page footer shows fictional address.
findings.recommendation: Replace with: 'Via Umberto I, n.121 — 96010 Ferla (SR), Sicilia'

findings.title: Transactional pages not noindexed
findings.description: /checkout/success, /checkout/subscription-success, /conferma-ordine, /feedback/[orderId], /manage-subscription are all indexable.
findings.recommendation: Create layout.tsx with generateNoIndexMetadata() for each page — pattern already exists in /cart/layout.tsx.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Product and Organization schema generators exist in codebase

findings.title: Product schema injected via JavaScript — never in initial HTML
findings.description: next/script afterInteractive strategy means structured data is client-side only. Googlebot first-wave crawl sees zero structured data.
findings.recommendation: Use inline <script type='application/ld+json'> in Server Components instead.

findings.title: Math.random() used for schema script ID
findings.description: id={`structured-data-${Math.random()}`} causes guaranteed React hydration mismatch on every render.
findings.recommendation: Use stable caller-provided IDs (e.g., 'sd-organization', 'sd-product').

findings.title: Organization schema incomplete
findings.description: address has only addressCountry: 'IT'. sameAs array is empty/commented out. telephone absent.
findings.recommendation: Add full PostalAddress, telephone, email, vatID, sameAs with actual social profile URLs.

findings.title: No LocalBusiness schema
findings.description: No LocalBusiness or FoodEstablishment schema anywhere on the site. Complete template provided in findings/local.md.
findings.recommendation: Add LocalBusiness / FoodEstablishment JSON-LD to homepage.

findings.title: aggregateRating never passed to Product schema
findings.description: generateProductSchema() accepts rating data but the call site in layout.tsx always passes undefined. No star ratings in SERPs.
findings.recommendation: Fetch review aggregate from MongoDB and pass to generateProductSchema() in layout.tsx.

findings.title: 6 pages with zero schema
findings.description: /products, /about, /contact, /faq, /sostenibilita, /smaltimento-rifiuti have no JSON-LD.
findings.recommendation: Add appropriate schema types: FAQPage (faq), ContactPage (contact), AboutPage or Organization (about).

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Self-hosted fonts with font-display:swap and calibrated fallback metrics

findings.title: 29 MB 4K hero video with no poster — estimated LCP 10–30s on mobile
findings.description: Hero video served from R2 CDN with no poster attribute. No preconnect for R2 origin. Browser must buffer first video frame before any above-fold LCP candidate exists.
findings.recommendation: Add WebP poster image (60–80 KB still from first frame). Add R2 preconnect. Encode 1080p VP9 version (~80% size reduction).

findings.title: Hero text has opacity-0 on SSR — zero LCP candidate
findings.description: HeroSection uses useState(false) + useEffect(() => setIsVisible(true)). SSR HTML ships with opacity-0 on all hero text. Combined with posterless video = zero LCP candidate for seconds.
findings.recommendation: Replace JS visibility state with CSS animation (animation-fill-mode: forwards) so text is visible in SSR HTML.

findings.title: Adobe Typekit CSS is render-blocking
findings.description: Synchronous <link> to use.typekit.net with font-display:auto. No preconnect. Adds 200–600ms to FCP on every page.
findings.recommendation: Add preconnect for use.typekit.net and p.typekit.net. Long-term: self-host via next/font/local.

findings.title: 70 KB loading spinner PNG preloaded at high priority
findings.description: Loading spinner preloaded at fetchpriority='high', displacing genuinely critical LCP resources from the preload queue.
findings.recommendation: Remove fetchpriority='high' from spinner image preload.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: AI crawlers implicitly allowed via wildcard robots.txt

findings.title: No llms.txt file
findings.description: Both /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt return 404. AI systems must infer brand facts from sparse crawl content.
findings.recommendation: Create /public/llms.txt. Complete template provided in findings/geo.md.

findings.title: FAQ page invisible to AI crawlers
findings.description: All Q&A content loads via client-side JavaScript. AI crawlers (static HTML parsers) see zero FAQ content from the site's highest-value citable asset.
findings.recommendation: Fix FaqListSection rendering bug (server-side render the Q&A pairs). Add FAQPage JSON-LD schema.

findings.title: No Wikipedia entity, YouTube channel, or Reddit mentions
findings.description: Three highest-correlation AI citation signals are absent. AI systems have no canonical entity reference for the brand.
findings.recommendation: Build off-site authority anchors in parallel with on-site fixes. Target Wikipedia citation once 3 notable press citations exist.

findings.title: OG image returns 404
findings.description: /images/og-image.jpg → 404. Every social share on all platforms shows blank image.
findings.recommendation: Add 1200×630px OG image to /public/images/ or update path to R2 CDN URL.

findings.title: Product images inaccessible (500 errors on product pages)
findings.description: Cannot audit product image alt text or quality — all product pages return HTTP 500.
findings.recommendation: Fix product page 500 errors first, then audit image alt text and file sizes.
